character_types: man driving while on the phone
visual_synopsis: A mustached man drives a black SUV along a dusty rural road through orchards with a mobile phone pressed to his ear for almost the entire sketch, intercut with exterior shots of the SUV and another car on the track. After a black cut near the end, a younger man is shown alone at the wheel of a second car in the same countryside, hunching over and peering around as he drives.
